_about: Source data for command-comparison.md (built by tools/command-table.js). aaMap: AA package/action -> our command, or '-: reason' when we deliberately do it differently. commands: findings per command of ours. packages: defaults for every command of a toolkit. AA behaviour is summarised in our own words.

aaMap.String/Evaluate variable: -: not adopted: reading a variable whose name is held in text hides the data flow from validation and refactoring; use a Dictionary keyed by name (ooa.dictionary/get) instead
aaMap.Data Table/Write to file stream: -: no stream type; write to a file (ooa.datatable/write_to_file) or keep the table in a variable
aaMap.JSON utilities/Start session: -: no sessions: JSON is an ordinary Dictionary/List variable (ooa.json/parse or read_file), which validates and shows in the variable watch
aaMap.XML/Start session: -: no sessions: actions take the XML text or a file and return the changed XML
aaMap.CSV/TXT/Close: -: nothing to close: the file is read in one step
aaMap.File/Copy Control Room file: -: repository files listed in the agent's 'files' are placed in the runner's workspace before the run; then use ooa.file/copy
aaMap.Excel advanced/Disable or enable real-ti: -: not needed: workbooks are edited as files with no visible Excel window, so there is no screen to update (ooa.excel_desktop drives Excel when a macro must run)
aaMap.Window/Assign: -: window variables are ordinary variables: core/set copies one; Capture and the window picker create them
aaMap.Python script/Close: -: no sessions: each step starts Python and ends it
aaMap.JavaScript/Close: -: no sessions: each step starts Node.js and ends it
aaMap.VBScript/Close: -: no sessions: each step starts the script host and ends it
aaMap.Database/Manage stored procedure: -: create or drop procedures with Insert/update/delete (ooa.database/execute) and the database's own SQL
aaMap.Trigger loop/Trigger loop: -: a Loop with the iterators ooa.triggerloop/file_arrives, process_starts or timer_tick (each event is one pass)
aaMap.Trigger loop/Handle: -: the Loop's children handle each event

core/if.diff: AA builds each condition from a typed form (one family per variable type, up to 32 conditions, And/Or). Ours: one condition editor with all/any/not groups, expressions and toolkit conditions; same operators plus between, not-in and the ignore-case/trim/line-break/date-only options (added 21 Oct).
core/if.ideas: Proposal: show the condition as a sentence in the canvas and offer 'test this condition' with the current variable values.

core/loop.diff: AA shows only the fields of the chosen loop type; ours showed all 15 fields at once. The built-in 'each key' and 'each value' iterators existed at run time but were missing from Studio's Loop type list.
core/loop.fixed: Fields now appear only for the chosen loop type (shown-when rules); Loop type list gained 'Each key' and 'Each value'; limits on count, max_iterations, from/to index.
core/loop.ideas: Done: safety limit (max_iterations) that AA lacks. Proposal: loop over pages of an API (cursor) as a built-in iterator.

core/break.diff: Same, plus a label to leave an outer loop (AA has no labels).

core/continue.diff: Same, plus a label for nested loops.

core/try.diff: AA: Catch by exception type, message and line to variables, 'continue on error in Catch'. Ours: catch by error-code patterns (more precise), message/line/details to variables, screenshot, rethrow, continueOnError (added 21 Oct). Typed error dictionary with code, message, suggestedFix, line, action, stepId.

core/throw.diff: AA: message only. Ours: code, message, suggested fix, details, retryable.

core/delay.diff: AA: fixed or random delay in seconds or milliseconds. Ours had the same.
core/delay.fixed: New unit 'minutes'; limits (no negative delays) shown in Studio and checked by the validator.
core/delay.ideas: Proposal: 'wait until a time of day' (e.g. until 18:00 local) as a delay mode.

core/wait_until.diff: AA: one condition with its own wait time, stop or carry on. Ours: any condition, timeout, poll interval, fail_on_timeout, output met.

core/pause.diff: AA Task Bot > Pause waits for a person. Ours adds a message and an optional automatic resume time-out.

core/stop.diff: AA Task Bot > Stop. Ours: success or failed status; Finally blocks still run.

core/run_bot.diff: AA Task Bot > Run: inputs, outputs to a dictionary, repeat, continue on error. Ours: same plus output_map to variables, timeout, shared sessions, error output.
core/run_bot.fixed: 'Delay between repeats' appears only when repeat is more than 1; limits on repeat and time-outs.

core/set.diff: Covers AA's Assign actions of every type (String, Number, Boolean, List, Dictionary, Record, Data Table, Credential) in one step with expressions and ${} interpolation.

core/log.diff: No AA equivalent in the editor (AA logs to file through the Logging package); ours writes to the run log with a level.

core/parallel.diff: No AA equivalent (AA runs steps one at a time). Ours: branches run at the same time.

ooa.string/find.diff: AA Find returns a 1-based position. Ours returns 0-based index, 1-based position, match, occurrence.
ooa.string/find.fixed: New outputs: regex capture groups, named groups, every match and the match count; limits on start and occurrence.
ooa.string/find.ideas: Done (typed outputs). Proposal: an AI-assisted 'build a pattern from examples' helper in Studio.

ooa.string/extract_text.diff: Same options (after/before markers with occurrence, ignore case, if not found, max length, remove line breaks).
ooa.string/extract_text.fixed: Occurrence fields show only when their marker is filled.

ooa.string/split.fixed: 'Ignore case' hidden for regex splits (use (?i) there); limit on max parts.

ooa.string/substring.fixed: Limits on start, length and end.

ooa.string/random_string.fixed: Letter case shows only when letters are on; length limited to 1-100000.

ooa.string/to_locale_number.diff: Defect found by the sample task: en-IN (the field's own example) grouped digits in threes (1,234,567).
ooa.string/to_locale_number.fixed: Lakh/crore grouping for India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Nepal (12,34,567).

ooa.string/to_number.diff: AA has To number and To locale number; ours is one action with locale and separator overrides.

ooa.number/format.diff: Same defect as Number to locale text for en-IN.

ooa.number/to_text.fixed: Rounding mode shows only when no custom pattern is used; decimals 0-20.

ooa.list/get_item.fixed: Default value shows only when 'if out of range' is 'default'.

ooa.list/remove_item.fixed: 'All occurrences' shows only when removing by value.

ooa.dictionary/get.fixed: Default shows only when 'fail if missing' is off.

ooa.datatable/aggregate.diff: New: AA has no grouping or summaries (sums per vendor need a loop and a dictionary).
ooa.datatable/aggregate.fixed: New action Group and summarise: group by columns; count, sum, avg, min, max, first, last, count_distinct.

ooa.datatable/filter.fixed: Value hidden for empty/not empty; match case only for text operators.

ooa.datatable/write_to_file.fixed: Delimiter, header, append and line ending show only for CSV.

ooa.datatable/change_column_type.fixed: Date format shows only for DateTime; impossible dates (31/02) are now refused instead of being changed to 28/02.

ooa.datatable/sum_column.ideas: Superseded by Group and summarise for anything beyond one total.

ooa.datetime/add.fixed: New unit business_days (skips weekends and an optional holiday list, shown only for that unit).
ooa.datetime/add.ideas: Done. Proposal: named holiday calendars kept in Command Center.

ooa.datetime/difference.fixed: New unit business_days (working days between two dates) with holidays.

ooa.datetime/parse.diff: Defect found by the sample task: 31/02/2026 was accepted and silently became 28 Feb.
ooa.datetime/parse.fixed: Strict reading: impossible dates fail with DATETIME.PARSE_FAILED; pattern hidden when a standard format is chosen.

ooa.datetime/is_valid.fixed: Strict check; 12-hour patterns (h) read the time too.

ooa.datetime/format.fixed: Pattern hidden when a standard format is chosen.

ooa.json/stringify.fixed: Indent shows only with pretty printing; limited to 0-10.

ooa.csv/read.diff: AA returns every value as text (as ours did), so arithmetic on a CSV column needs conversions; the sample task showed 0 + '1' concatenating.
ooa.csv/read.fixed: New option detect_types: numbers, true/false and ISO dates become typed values; codes with leading zeros stay text. Limits on skip_lines and max_rows.

ooa.file/list.diff: AA has no list action (its loop 'each file in folder' lists); ours lists with size and age filters.
ooa.file/list.fixed: New sort_by (name, modified, size) and descending; new outputs count and first (e.g. the newest file); limits on the size and age filters.
ooa.file/list.ideas: Done: 'latest file in a folder' in one step.

ooa.file/read_variables.diff: New: AA Text file > Read variables had no equivalent.
ooa.file/read_variables.fixed: New action: name=value lines into a Dictionary (separator, encoding, trim; # and ; comments skipped).

ooa.file/wait_for_file.diff: New: AA has no step that waits for a download or export to finish (people add fixed delays).
ooa.file/wait_for_file.fixed: New action: waits until a file (name may use * and ?) appears and stops growing; skips .crdownload/.part/.tmp and ~$ lock files; time-out with fail or carry on.

ooa.file/size_is (condition).diff: New: AA's If has 'file size' conditions.
ooa.file/size_is (condition).fixed: New condition: compare size in bytes, KB, MB or GB.

ooa.file/date_is (condition).diff: New: AA's If has 'file date' conditions.
ooa.file/date_is (condition).fixed: New condition: modified or created date before/after/on a date, or older/newer than N days.

ooa.file/has_extension (condition).diff: New: AA's If has a 'file extension' condition.
ooa.file/has_extension (condition).fixed: New condition: one or more extensions, any case, with or without the dot.

ooa.file/copy.fixed: 'Keep both' shows only when overwrite is off.

ooa.file/move.fixed: 'Keep both' shows only when overwrite is off.

ooa.file/print_files.diff: An empty selection fails with FILE.NO_FILES (AA silently prints nothing).
ooa.file/print_files.fixed: The files list and the folder/pattern options exclude each other in the form; copies 1-999.

ooa.file/delete.fixed: Limits on the size and age filters.

ooa.folder/subfolders (iterator).diff: New: AA Loop 'each folder in folder' had no iterator of ours.
ooa.folder/subfolders (iterator).fixed: New loop iterator with sub-folders at any depth and a name pattern.

ooa.folder/create.ideas: Proposal: one error-code family for the File and Folder toolkits (today FILE.NOT_FOUND and FOLDER.NOT_FOUND both occur), with the old codes kept as aliases.

ooa.excel/rows (iterator).diff: New: AA's Loop has 'each row in an Excel worksheet'; ours needed Get all cells first.
ooa.excel/rows (iterator).fixed: New loop iterator: each row (of the sheet or a range) as a record by header names; hidden rows can be skipped.

ooa.excel/protect_sheet.diff: The password was a plain String field, unlike Open and Save which take vault credentials.
ooa.excel/protect_sheet.fixed: Password is a Credential input (vault or text); an empty password is refused instead of silently leaving the sheet unprotected.

ooa.excel/filter.fixed: 'Value to' shows only for between; value hidden for empty/not empty; match case only for text operators.

ooa.excel/delete_rows.fixed: Row and count limited to 1 or more, so row 0 is reported before the run instead of failing in it.

ooa.excel/switch_sheet.fixed: Sheet name and 1-based index exclude each other in the form.

ooa.excel/delete_sheet.fixed: Name and index exclude each other.

ooa.excel/hide_sheet.fixed: Name and index exclude each other.

ooa.excel/unhide_sheet.fixed: Name and index exclude each other.

ooa.excel/rename_sheet.fixed: Name and index exclude each other.

ooa.excel/open.diff: Missing file gives EXCEL.NOT_FOUND (the File toolkit uses FILE.NOT_FOUND).
ooa.excel/open.ideas: Proposal: let a Catch match any not-found error (*.NOT_FOUND) so toolkits need not share codes.

ooa.excel/sort_range.fixed: 'Then descending' shows only with a second sort column.

ooa.excel/insert_rows.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/hide_rows.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/unhide_rows.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/delete_columns.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/insert_columns.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/hide_columns.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/unhide_columns.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/read_column.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/read_row.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/cell_address.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/column_name.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/add_sheet.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.excel/insert_table_column.fixed: Limits on row, column, count or position (1-based).

ooa.browser/open.diff: Checked in AA's editor: what to open (existing tab, new tab, new window), browser incl. 'default browser', link, time-out in seconds (240, min 9). Ours: same modes; browser edge/chrome/chromium/firefox (no 'default'); time-out in milliseconds.
ooa.browser/open.fixed: Browser, headless and download folder show only for a new window; the tab picker only for new/existing tab; time-out at least 1 s.
ooa.browser/open.ideas: Proposal: a 'default browser' choice read from the user's Windows setting.

ooa.browser/close.diff: AA: tab, window or all browsers with a tab picker and a time-out. Ours: also 'this session'; no time-out (the step time-out applies).
ooa.browser/close.fixed: Tab picker shows only for tab/window.

ooa.browser/download_url.diff: AA Download file: URL, save to, overwrite (sign-in implied). Ours adds explicit user/password and a time-out.

ooa.browser/get_page_source.diff: Same (tab, optional iframe, time-out, output); ours can also save to a file.

ooa.browser/run_javascript.diff: Same (tab, iframe, script typed or from a file, time-out).
ooa.browser/run_javascript.fixed: Script and script file exclude each other in the form, as in AA.

ooa.browser/call_javascript_function.diff: Same (function, arguments, return type; AA defaults the return type to none, ours to any).

ooa.browser/find_broken_links.diff: Same options; AA requires the CSV file and defaults to ANSI, ours makes the file optional (table output) and defaults to UTF-8.
ooa.browser/find_broken_links.fixed: Pages limit only for scope site; append and encoding only with a CSV file; limits on threads and time-outs.

ooa.browser/history.diff: AA Go back: steps and 'error if too many'; ours also forward and refresh.
ooa.browser/history.fixed: Steps and the error option show only for back/forward.

ooa.browser/click.diff: With a plain selector a missing element fails as BROWSER.TIMEOUT, with a captured object as BROWSER.OBJECT_NOT_FOUND, so one Catch may not see both.
ooa.browser/click.ideas: Proposal: error-code aliases (one family for 'not found') so Catch blocks can match both without breaking existing ones.

ooa.window/activate.diff: Defect found by the sample task on the real desktop: Activate reported success while Windows' focus lock kept another app in front.
ooa.window/activate.fixed: Activate now checks the window really is in front; if Windows refuses, it attaches to the foreground input and sends an ALT tap (the usual workaround), and otherwise fails with WINDOW.NOT_ACTIVATED. Capture window and the window events use the same routine.

ooa.window/close_all.diff: Checked in AA's editor: AA closes all windows except a 'keep open' list. Ours closes windows matching a title (safer).
ooa.window/close_all.fixed: New keep list; the agent's own windows (run window, Studio) are never closed.

ooa.window/wait_for.diff: Checked in AA's editor: AA waits for a window to open or to close, 5 s default, and raising an error is optional. Ours only waited for it to open and always failed.
ooa.window/wait_for.fixed: New state (open or close), fail_on_timeout and output met.

ooa.window/set_title.diff: Same (AA can match the window by regular expression; ours matches title text or alternatives).

ooa.window/move_resize.diff: AA Resize needs all four values; ours leaves empty ones unchanged.

ooa.image/wait_for_screen_change.diff: New: AA's Wait for screen change (region relative to a window or the screen, initial wait, time-out) had no equivalent.
ooa.image/wait_for_screen_change.fixed: New action with mode change or settle (wait until the screen stops changing), threshold, window, initial wait, fail or carry on.
ooa.image/wait_for_screen_change.ideas: Done: 'settle' replaces fixed delays after loading.

ooa.desktop/prompt_value.diff: Defect found by the sample task: on time-out the value was empty instead of the default.
ooa.desktop/prompt_value.fixed: Time-out returns the default; new output timed_out.

ooa.desktop/type_text.diff: Text in brackets that is not a key name is typed as text (by design), so a typo such as [ENTRE] is typed silently.
ooa.desktop/type_text.fixed: Keystroke delay shows only for keystrokes; restore clipboard only for paste.
ooa.desktop/type_text.ideas: Proposal: warn in the run log when a bracketed word looks like a key name but is unknown.

ooa.desktop/prompt_yes_no.fixed: 'Answer on time-out' shows only when a time-out is set.

ooa.application/stop_program.fixed: Process id and program name exclude each other in the form.

ooa.email/connect.diff: Checked in AA's editor: Outlook / email server / EWS, SSL, host, port, IMAP or POP3, credential user and password, time-out 120 s (10-300). Ours: email server only (Microsoft 365 through the Graph toolkit), time-out 15 s.
ooa.email/connect.fixed: New smtp_host, smtp_port and smtp_security: the session keeps an outgoing server so Send, Reply and Forward need no server or sign-in of their own; time-out limited to 1-300 s.
ooa.email/connect.ideas: Done. Proposal: a local-Outlook connection for desktops without IMAP access.

ooa.email/send.diff: Checked in AA's editor: recipients, reply-to, 'raise error if addresses invalid', importance, subject, attachments, body, then SMTP host and port, 'server requires authentication' and credentials on every send. Ours always signed in and always failed on invalid addresses (kept: safer).
ooa.email/send.fixed: SMTP host and user are optional when the mailbox session has an outgoing server; with no password or token the server is used without signing in (internal relay).

ooa.email/reply.fixed: Uses the session's outgoing server when the SMTP fields are empty; sign-in optional.

ooa.email/reply_all.fixed: Uses the session's outgoing server when the SMTP fields are empty; sign-in optional.

ooa.email/forward.fixed: Uses the session's outgoing server when the SMTP fields are empty; sign-in optional.

ooa.email/delete_all.diff: Defect found by the sample task: a folder already open in the session did not see emails moved into it later, so Delete all removed 1 of 3.
ooa.email/delete_all.fixed: An open IMAP folder is refreshed (NOOP) each time a step uses it; the same fix applies to every mailbox action.

ooa.word/open.diff: Checked in AA's editor: file, read-write or read-only, open password, edit password, session. Ours: same except the edit password (not a security feature).

ooa.word/insert_text.diff: Checked in AA's editor: at the cursor, start, end or a bookmark; text plain or HTML. Ours: start, end, bookmark, after or before a text; plain text with formatting options.
ooa.word/insert_text.fixed: Writing into a new document no longer leaves a blank first paragraph.
ooa.word/insert_text.ideas: Proposal: HTML input (bold, italic, lists) converted to Word formatting.

ooa.word/add_paragraph.diff: Defect found by the sample task: a new document started with an empty paragraph, so generated documents began with a blank line and paragraph numbers were off by one.
ooa.word/add_paragraph.fixed: The first paragraph added to a new document uses the existing blank paragraph.

ooa.word/replace_text.diff: Checked in AA's editor: match case, whole words, range (full document, a page or a paragraph index), occurrence. Ours had no range.
ooa.word/replace_text.fixed: New from_paragraph / to_paragraph range (1-based body paragraphs).
ooa.word/replace_text.ideas: Page ranges need Word's own layout engine (not available without Word).

ooa.word/format_text.diff: AA takes the colour as a decimal number; ours takes hex. AA limits size to 1-1638.
ooa.word/format_text.fixed: Paragraph range as for Replace text; size limited to 1-1638.

ooa.powerpoint/insert_text.diff: Checked in AA's editor: inserts on the current slide by default, position in centimetres, formatting. Ours needed a slide number on every insert and uses points.
ooa.powerpoint/insert_text.fixed: Slide is optional: the last slide (usually the one just added) when empty.

ooa.powerpoint/add_slide.diff: Checked in AA's editor: layout and position; ours also sets title and body text.

ooa.pdf/extract_text.diff: Checked in AA's editor: user and owner passwords, plain or structured text, page range, save to .txt, overwrite, properties to a dictionary. Ours: same (properties via Get document properties).

ooa.pdf/merge.diff: AA's PDFUtils package also merges every PDF in a folder; ours needed a list.
ooa.pdf/merge.fixed: New folder, pattern and sort_by inputs; output files lists what was merged; the target is never merged into itself.

ooa.pdf/encrypt.diff: Passwords must be vault credentials (plain text refused): safer than AA's 'insecure string' option.

ooa.system/get_environment_variable.diff: Defect found by the sample task: a value set with Set environment variable (process scope) was invisible to Get environment variable in the same run.
ooa.system/get_environment_variable.fixed: Values set earlier in the run are returned first.

ooa.services/start.diff: An unknown service gave the generic SERVICES.FAILED.
ooa.services/start.fixed: Unknown services fail with SERVICES.NOT_FOUND (start, stop, pause, resume, restart), as Get status already did; wait time shows only when waiting.

ooa.script/run_python_function.diff: Checked in AA's editor: AA opens a Python session from a file or a typed script, runs a function with one argument, errors optional. Ours: a function from a file, any number of arguments and keyword arguments, typed result, errors on by default.
ooa.script/run_python_function.fixed: New script input: the function's code can be typed instead of a file (also for JavaScript and VBScript functions); script and file exclude each other in the form.

ooa.script/run_javascript_function.fixed: Typed script as an alternative to a file.

ooa.script/run_vbscript_function.fixed: Typed script as an alternative to a file.

ooa.script/run_python.fixed: Script and file exclude each other in the form; time-out at least 1 s.

ooa.rest/request.diff: Checked in AA's editor (Post method): URI, proxy, authentication, headers, content type, body with substitutions, failure response, insecure TLS, accept cookies, time-out, client keystore, output. Ours has all of these.
ooa.rest/request.fixed: Body fields hidden for GET; JSON, form and raw body exclude each other; proxy sign-in only with a proxy; certificate password only with a certificate.

ooa.crypto/decrypt_text.diff: Decrypted text is returned as a secret (masked in logs and outputs), so it never leaks into run history.

ooa.crypto/rsa_decrypt.diff: Decrypted text is returned as a secret (masked).
ooa.crypto/rsa_decrypt.ideas: Proposal: take private keys from the vault instead of a file path.

ooa.network/check_port.fixed: Port limited to 1-65535 (checked before the run); time-outs at least 1 ms.

ooa.file_transfer/connect.fixed: SFTP-only options (private key, passphrase, host key) and FTP-only options (passive mode, TLS mode, transfer mode) show only for their protocol; port 1-65535.

ooa.currency/convert.fixed: Address and rates path show only for a JSON source; fixed rates only for the fixed source; decimals 0-10.

ooa.servicenow/query.diff: Checked in AA's editor (Get Multiple Records): table, fields, filter by name/value pairs or a query, limit (0 = all). Ours needed ServiceNow's encoded query syntax.
ooa.servicenow/query.fixed: New filter input: field to value pairs, no query syntax needed (combined with query when both are given); local http test servers accepted.

ooa.servicenow/create_record.fixed: Address pattern accepts http://localhost for test servers (https still required for real instances).

ooa.jira/create_issue.diff: Checked in AA's editor: project key, issue type, summary (up to 255 characters), description, priority (Medium by default), assignee email, labels, components, custom fields; output key, id, address and full reply. Ours: same plus due date and parent issue; priority left to the project default.

ooa.slack/post_message.diff: Defect found by the connector smoke test: a reply that is not a Slack answer gave the code SLACK.NULL.
ooa.slack/post_message.fixed: Such replies fail with SLACK.BAD_RESPONSE and a hint about base_url or a proxy (all Slack commands).

ooa.databricks/upload_file.diff: Defect found by the connector smoke test: a reply without an upload handle crashed with a NullPointerException.

ooa.databricks/delete_file.diff: New: AA Databricks Delete file had no equivalent.
ooa.databricks/delete_file.fixed: New action for volumes, the workspace and DBFS (recursive folders on DBFS).

ooa.asana/duplicate_task.fixed: New action; choose what is copied along.

ooa.asana/update_project.fixed: New action (name, notes, owner, due date, archived, other fields).

ooa.asana/delete_project.fixed: New action, with a confirm safeguard.

ooa.asana/create_team.fixed: New Create, Get and Update team actions.

ooa.asana/update_comment.diff: New: AA Asana Update and Delete comment.

ooa.asana/download_attachment.diff: New: AA Asana Download and Delete attachment.
ooa.asana/download_attachment.fixed: New actions; links to Google Drive or Box are reported clearly instead of downloading a web page.

ooa.azure_devops/create_test_case.diff: New: AA Azure DevOps test management (plans, suites, cases, points, runs) had no equivalent; ours covered work items, repositories and pipelines.
ooa.azure_devops/create_test_case.fixed: 19 new actions: list/get/create/edit/delete test plans, create/edit/delete suites (static, requirement, query), add/remove test cases, create test case with steps, list/update test points, create/get test runs, get/create/edit/delete pipelines.

ooa.docusign/add_recipients.fixed: New action: signers and copy recipients with signing order.

ooa.docusign/download_zip.diff: New: AA DocuSign Download signed ZIP.

ooa.microsoft365/excel_find_next_empty_c.diff: New: AA Microsoft 365 Excel Find / Go to next empty cell.
ooa.microsoft365/excel_find_next_empty_c.fixed: New action: first empty cell down a column or along a row.

ooa.active_directory/get_user.diff: Defect found by the directory sample: users were looked up by objectCategory, which only Active Directory fills in, so Samba or OpenLDAP with an AD schema found nobody.
ooa.active_directory/get_user.fixed: Lookups use objectClass user and not computer (same result on AD, works on other directories).

ooa.active_directory/get_group_members.diff: Defect found by the directory sample: members were found only through memberOf, which some directories do not keep.
ooa.active_directory/get_group_members.fixed: Falls back to the group's own member list when memberOf gives nothing.

ooa.active_directory/connect.diff: Same as AA (address, bind user, credential, base DN); runs against an in-memory directory in the samples.

ooa.ocr/read_screen.diff: Defect found by the smoke test: a whole multi-monitor screen at scale 2 ran out of memory.
ooa.ocr/read_screen.fixed: The enlarged image is capped at about 25 megapixels; scale limits corrected to 1-5 (what the code accepts).

ooa.ocr/click_text.fixed: Same memory cap as Read text from screen.

ooa.genai/prompt.diff: AA lists one package per provider (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, SageMaker, Hugging Face); ours has one set of actions with a provider choice and named model connections.

ooa.genai/classify.diff: An answer outside the given labels fails with AI.LABEL_NOT_ALLOWED instead of passing through.

ooa.sap/run_transaction.diff: SAP GUI scripting actions match AA's SAP package. AA's SAP BAPI package is not built: it needs the customer's licensed SAP Java Connector at run time.
